entries.title: Spatial Paired Lookahead Search
entries.description: Frozen v4 policy with the v7 construction pair and exact-score comparison at matched depths 2/4/6/8. Deadline cutoff retains the deepest completed pair under fixed root-prior continuation. No learned value, retraining or promotion; historical spatial-ppo name retained.

entries.title: Spatial Conditional Construction Search
entries.description: Frozen v4 policy weights with one alternative first build, a freshly recomputed conditional suffix, and bounded two-turn exact-score comparison. No learned value, retraining or promotion; historical spatial-ppo name retained.

entries.title: Spatial Construction Search
entries.description: Frozen v4 policy weights with two construction candidates and a bounded two-turn rollout using exact core score differences. No learned value, retraining or promotion; historical spatial-ppo name retained.

entries.title: Spatial Value-Guided Search
entries.description: Value-head calibration on frozen v4 features and a bounded two-candidate disruption search, with separate generated SpatialV5Weights. Historical spatial-ppo name retained; no PPO or promotion.

entries.title: Distillation From V09
entries.description: Supervised distillation from frozen v09 hard actions, with separate generated SpatialV4Weights and the unchanged spatial model/runtime. No PPO in this stage; historical spatial-ppo naming retained. No promotion.

entries.title: Spatial PPO Fixed Opponent Pool
entries.description: Warm-started from frozen spatial-ppo-v2 weights, with one learner seat against a fixed opponent pool. Unchanged spatial-v1 observation, network and runtime; separate generated SpatialV3Weights and no promotion. docs/spatial-ppo-v3.md.

entries.title: Spatial PPO Longer Training
entries.description: New generated weights from a longer fixed PPO run using the unchanged spatial-v1 observation, network and runtime; not promoted. docs/spatial-ppo-v2.md.

entries.title: Spatial PPO Untrained Initializer
entries.description: Frozen seed-20261008 initializer, before gradients, in the unchanged spatial-v1 runtime. Matched learning diagnostic control for spatial-ppo-v2; not a selected policy.

entries.title: Spatial PPO Prototype
entries.description: Independent 3439-weight spatial policy/value, four-update PPO technical run; no search or promotion. docs/spatial-ppo-v1.md.

entries.title: Autoplace
entries.description: AUTOPLACE toward the first unfinished desired connection.

entries.title: Greedy Routes
entries.description: Cheapest routes ranked by track ownership and remaining earning time.

entries.title: Route Evaluation
entries.description: Simulated route income, ownership stealing and sabotage evaluation.

entries.title: Risk Aware
entries.description: Adds vulnerability evaluation, backup routes and deliberate map closure.

entries.title: Network Extension
entries.description: Spends otherwise idle paint extending the network near rails and towns.

entries.title: Disrupt Reserve
entries.description: Reserves 6 ms for sabotage by cutting route search short; not a timing guarantee.

entries.title: Simultaneous Rollout
entries.description: Eight-turn construction and sabotage rollouts against two opponent route priorities.

entries.title: Network After Base
entries.description: Quick income plus single-cell network moves after ordinary rollout comparisons finish.

entries.title: Protected Opening
entries.description: Claims protected town approaches over the first three turns, then uses Network After Base.

entries.title: Never Idle
entries.description: Protected Opening plus leftover paint spent on stable or protected cells next to own rails after the rollout search; RHEA code removed.

entries.title: Boss Model
entries.description: Never Idle plus the two-stage boss-like chooser at the real turn, the same chooser as the simulated opponent and for own future disrupts inside the rollout, the route-traffic term, and the three validated runtime flags (incremental ink refresh, fast cheapest path, batched refresh); the exact stage2-compute-v1 candidate D, promoted 2026-10-23.

entries.title: Sabotage First
entries.description: Independent sticky-target sabotage with short-horizon route construction.

entries.title: Leader Style
entries.description: Fast heuristic calibrated on the arena leader (Indrill): a sticky DISRUPT every turn on unfinished opponent construction, greedy cheapest-route construction (places on ~42% of turns), protected opening. Frozen; never retuned.

entries.title: Leader Style, Never Idle
entries.description: leader-v1 sabotage with construction rebuilt from the per-cell replay study: most valuable completion route over a 24-turn horizon (shared or enemy-avoiding), cheapest remaining completion as fallback, leftover paint next to own earning rails. Frozen; never retuned.

entries.title: Neural Imitation
entries.description: Behaviour-cloned policy: two small conditional-logit MLPs (sabotage region, sequential placement cell) over engine-grounded candidate features, trained on the arena leader's replays. Hard rules only for closing inks. Weights in btk.bot.neural.NeuralWeights.

entries.title: Neural Outcome Fine-tuning
entries.description: Outcome fine-tuning of neural-v1, fixed 1536 training games: 645/1000 vs v09 (64.5%), local PASS_1000. Strict process 1/8 timeout; boss unplayed, not ready or promoted. Generated NeuralV2Weights; docs/neural-policy-v2.md.

entries.title: Neural Cooperative Deadline
entries.description: Exact neural-v2 weights and completed decisions with cooperative deadlines in features and scoring. Incomplete passes are discarded while earlier completed actions remain. Separate timing experiment; no retraining or promotion.

entries.title: Neural Lower Build Exploration
entries.description: Fixed outcome-training repeat from neural-v1 with construction sampling temperature 0.5, sabotage and teacher temperature 1. Unchanged neural-v3 deadline-aware runtime and features; new generated NeuralV4Weights. Separate unpromoted experiment; docs/neural-policy-v4.md.

entries.title: Neural Exact Feature Optimization
entries.description: Exact neural-v3 weights, candidate order, greedy decisions and cooperative deadline with optimized feature preparation. No retraining or policy change; separate unpromoted runtime experiment.

entries.title: Neural Resumable Feature Paths
entries.description: Exact neural-v5 weights, features, candidate order and cooperative deadline with resumable Dijkstra per source town and semantic block mask. No retraining or policy change; separate unpromoted runtime experiment.

entries.title: Neural Deadline Extension
entries.description: Frozen V6 policy and V2 weights with bounded stable own-network construction only after a neural deadline cutoff; completed choices and ample-time behavior are preserved.

entries.title: Global Town Context
entries.description: Separate greedy spatial policy with distance-weighted town embeddings broadcast over the board. Fixed supervised experiment; no search or strategy promotion. docs/spatial-ppo-v9.md.

entries.title: Longer Full-Corpus Imitation
entries.description: Continue the original v4 supervised run on its unchanged full training corpus. Same spatial model, ordered imitation objective and greedy runtime; no search or strategy promotion. docs/spatial-ppo-v10.md.

entries.title: Indrill Action Values
entries.description: Compact prototype inspired by Indrill's forum post: risk-aware connection observations, a neural Q model trained from score and terminal outcomes, additive whole-quota construction and region ink decisions. Rejected locally (0/300 vs v09). Generated weights in btk.bot.current.IndrillWeights.

entries.title: Learned Position Value
entries.description: Q-learning follow-up: learned board-value baseline and WAIT plus additive construction/ink advantages. Fixed 960-game/14,000-update training; rejected locally (0/300 vs v09), not promoted. docs/indrill-q-v2.md.

entries.title: Indrill Forum Readout
entries.description: Hand readout of Indrill's published route observation: priority-path and good-cell scores, exact paint-3 knapsack, mean region ink. No learned weights. Rejected locally (14/300 vs v09). docs/indrill-forum-v1.md.

entries.title: Working Copy
entries.description: Live policy and defaults; not an immutable experiment or archived executable.

entries.title: Submission Wrapper
entries.description: Live MainBot runtime wrapper; does not identify an existing Player.java artifact.

entries.title: Income Guard
entries.description: Veto affordable builds that reduce the known-state income difference.
entries.historicalEvidence: 48.1% vs v05, 428 games; not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, build experiments at 7557d33.

entries.title: Build Direction
entries.description: Choose which end of the selected route to build first.
entries.historicalEvidence: 52.3% vs v05, 428 games; inconclusive, not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, 7557d33.

entries.title: Early Disrupt
entries.description: Prepare a ready-to-ink sabotage fallback before route search.
entries.historicalEvidence: 49.8% vs v05, 428 games; not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, 2765afa.

entries.title: Reply Rerank
entries.description: Rerank four affordable build choices against two predicted simultaneous replies.
entries.historicalEvidence: 46.5% vs v05, 428 games; not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, d464c9f.

entries.title: Interruptible Evaluation
entries.description: Discard incomplete vulnerability evaluations at the build time cutoff.
entries.historicalEvidence: 51.3% vs v05, 300 games; inconclusive, not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, fc568af.

entries.title: Delayed Sabotage Discount
entries.description: Discount sabotage targets that need additional hits before ink.
entries.historicalEvidence: 49.3% vs v05, 300 games; not promoted. docs/DEVLOG.md, f665fb5.

entries.title: Boss Imitation
entries.description: Imitation of the Silver arena boss fitted on its canonical replays: sticky four-hit sabotage chosen by a conditional logit, own-only construction avoiding regions at instability >= 2, single-cell steals, idle when nothing is profitable. Screening opponent for the boss meta (docs/boss-proxy-v1.md); frozen, never retuned.
